visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with manicured nails reaches out to touch a yellow and white duvet patterned with Peter Rabbit illustrations. The duvet lies atop a bed in a bright, modern indoor bedroom featuring a large window and a minimalist floor lamp in the soft-focus background. White variety-style text overlays appear centrally over the bedding. (2) The hand lifts the edge of the duvet to reveal a beige, linen-textured flat sheet beneath it. The camera follows the hand's motion with a slight handheld jitter, transitioning the view toward the head of the bed where light blue pillowcases are visible. Updated text descriptions appear at the bottom. (3) The perspective shifts to a smaller white blanket featuring bright, colorful anime character prints from Ojamajo Doremi. The hand adjusts this smaller throw blanket, highlighting the contrast in styles. The setting remains the well-lit bedroom interior with consistent, even natural lighting. (4) The final shot focuses on the headboard area, revealing a mixture of traditional floral pillows alongside a prominent blue anime-themed cushion featuring Lycoris Recoil characters. A nightstand cluttered with various cosmetic bottles and skincare products is visible in the background left. Closing text overlays summarize the eclectic mix of pillows.
